verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַן אֱלִיה֗וּא וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an ’ĕ·lî·hū way·yō·mar
verses.literal: Then Elihu continued . . .
verses.literalPt: RESPONDEU mais Eliú, dizendo:

verses.original: שִׁמְע֣וּ חֲכָמִ֣ים מִלָּ֑י וְ֝יֹדְעִ֗ים הַאֲזִ֥ינוּ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū ḥă·ḵā·mîm mil·lāy wə·yō·ḏə·‘îm ha·’ă·zî·nū lî
verses.literal: Hear my words O wise men give ear to me O men of learning
verses.literalPt: Ouvi, vós, sábios, as minhas razões; e vós, entendidos, inclinai os ouvidos para mim.

verses.original: כִּי־ אֹ֭זֶן מִלִּ֣ין תִּבְחָ֑ן וְ֝חֵ֗ךְ יִטְעַ֥ם לֶאֱכֹֽל׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’ō·zen mil·lîn tiḇ·ḥān wə·ḥêḵ yiṭ·‘am le·’ĕ·ḵōl
verses.literal: For the ear tests words as the mouth tastes food
verses.literalPt: Porque o ouvido prova as palavras, como o paladar experimenta a comida.

verses.original: מִשְׁפָּ֥ט נִבְחֲרָה־ לָּ֑נוּ נֵדְעָ֖ה בֵינֵ֣ינוּ מַה־ טּֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: miš·pāṭ niḇ·ḥă·rāh- lā·nū nê·ḏə·‘āh ḇê·nê·nū mah- ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: Let us choose for ourselves what is right let us learn together what is good
verses.literalPt: O que é direito escolhamos para nós; e conheçamos entre nós o que é bom.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אָ֭מַר אִיּ֣וֹב צָדַ֑קְתִּי וְ֝אֵ֗ל הֵסִ֥יר מִשְׁפָּטִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’ā·mar ’î·yō·wḇ ṣā·ḏaq·tî wə·’êl hê·sîr miš·pā·ṭî
verses.literal: For Job has declared I am righteous yet God has deprived me of justice
verses.literalPt: Porque Jó disse: Sou justo, e Deus tirou o meu direito.

verses.original: עַל־ מִשְׁפָּטִ֥י אֲכַזֵּ֑ב אָנ֖וּשׁ חִצִּ֣י בְלִי־ פָֽשַׁע׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- miš·pā·ṭî ’ă·ḵaz·zêḇ ’ā·nūš ḥiṣ·ṣî ḇə·lî- p̄ā·ša‘
verses.literal: Would I lie about my case My wound is incurable though I am without transgression
verses.literalPt: Apesar do meu direito sou considerado mentiroso; a minha ferida é incurável, embora eu esteja sem transgressão.

verses.original: מִי־ גֶ֥בֶר כְּאִיּ֑וֹב יִֽשְׁתֶּה־ לַּ֥עַג כַּמָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: mî- ḡe·ḇer kə·’î·yō·wḇ yiš·teh- la·‘aḡ kam·mā·yim
verses.literal: What man is like Job who drinks up derision like water
verses.literalPt: Que homem há como Jó, que bebe a zombaria como água?

verses.original: וְאָרַ֣ח לְ֭חֶבְרָה עִם־ פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן וְ֝לָלֶ֗כֶת עִם־ אַנְשֵׁי־ רֶֽשַׁע׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·raḥ lə·ḥeḇ·rāh ‘im- pō·‘ă·lê ’ā·wen wə·lā·le·ḵeṯ ‘im- ’an·šê- re·ša‘
verses.literal: He keeps company with evildoers . . . and walks with wicked men
verses.literalPt: E caminha em companhia dos que praticam a iniqüidade, e anda com homens ímpios?

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אָ֭מַר לֹ֣א יִסְכָּן־ גָּ֑בֶר בִּ֝רְצֹת֗וֹ עִם־ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’ā·mar lō yis·kān- gā·ḇer bir·ṣō·ṯōw ‘im- ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: For he has said It profits a man nothing that he should delight in God
verses.literalPt: Porque disse: De nada aproveita ao homem o comprazer-se em Deus.

verses.original: לָכֵ֤ן׀ אַ֥נֲשֵׁ֥י לֵבָ֗ב שִׁמְע֫וּ לִ֥י חָלִ֖לָה לָאֵ֥ל מֵרֶ֗שַׁע וְשַׁדַּ֥י מֵעָֽוֶל׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ’a·nă·šê lê·ḇāḇ šim·‘ū lî ḥā·li·lāh lā·’êl mê·re·ša‘ wə·šad·day mê·‘ā·wel
verses.literal: Therefore listen to me O men of understanding Far be it from God to do wrong and from the Almighty to act unjustly
verses.literalPt: Portanto vós, homens de entendimento, escutai-me: Longe de Deus esteja o praticar a maldade e do Todo-Poderoso o cometer a perversidade!

verses.original: כִּ֤י פֹ֣עַל אָ֭דָם יְשַׁלֶּם־ ל֑וֹ וּֽכְאֹ֥רַח אִ֝֗ישׁ יַמְצִאֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî p̄ō·‘al ’ā·ḏām yə·šal·lem- lōw ū·ḵə·’ō·raḥ ’îš yam·ṣi·’en·nū
verses.literal: For according to a man’s deeds He repays him according to a man’s ways He brings consequences
verses.literalPt: Porque, segundo a obra do homem, ele lhe paga; e faz a cada um segundo o seu caminho.

verses.original: אַף־ אָמְנָ֗ם אֵ֥ל לֹֽא־ יַרְשִׁ֑יעַ וְ֝שַׁדַּ֗י לֹֽא־ יְעַוֵּ֥ת מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄- ’ā·mə·nām ’êl lō- yar·šî·a‘ wə·šad·day lō- yə·‘aw·wêṯ miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: Indeed it is true that God does not act wickedly and the Almighty does not pervert justice
verses.literalPt: Também, na verdade, Deus não procede impiamente; nem o Todo-Poderoso perverte o juízo.

verses.original: מִֽי־ פָקַ֣ד עָלָ֣יו אָ֑רְצָה וּמִ֥י שָׂ֝֗ם תֵּבֵ֥ל כֻּלָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: mî- p̄ā·qaḏ ‘ā·lāw ’ā·rə·ṣāh ū·mî śām tê·ḇêl kul·lāh
verses.literal: Who gave Him charge over the earth Who appointed Him over the whole world
verses.literalPt: Quem lhe entregou o governo da terra? E quem fez todo o mundo?

verses.original: אִם־ יָשִׂ֣ים אֵלָ֣יו לִבּ֑וֹ רוּח֥וֹ וְ֝נִשְׁמָת֗וֹ אֵלָ֥יו יֶאֱסֹֽף׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- yā·śîm ’ê·lāw lib·bōw rū·ḥōw wə·niš·mā·ṯōw ’ê·lāw ye·’ĕ·sōp̄
verses.literal: If He were to set His heart to it and withdraw His Spirit and breath . . .
verses.literalPt: Se ele pusesse o seu coração contra o homem, e recolhesse para si o seu espírito e o seu fôlego,

verses.original: יִגְוַ֣ע כָּל־ בָּשָׂ֣ר יָ֑חַד וְ֝אָדָ֗ם עַל־ עָפָ֥ר יָשֽׁוּב׃
verses.transliteration: yiḡ·wa‘ kāl- bā·śār yā·ḥaḏ wə·’ā·ḏām ‘al- ‘ā·p̄ār yā·šūḇ
verses.literal: all flesh would perish together and mankind would return to the dust
verses.literalPt: Toda a carne juntamente expiraria, e o homem voltaria para o pó.

verses.original: וְאִם־ בִּ֥ינָה שִׁמְעָה־ זֹּ֑את הַ֝אֲזִ֗ינָה לְק֣וֹל מִלָּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- bî·nāh šim·‘āh- zōṯ ha·’ă·zî·nāh lə·qō·wl mil·lāy
verses.literal: If you have understanding hear this listen to . . . my words
verses.literalPt: Se, pois, há em ti entendimento, ouve isto; inclina os ouvidos ao som da minha palavra.

verses.original: הַאַ֬ף שׂוֹנֵ֣א מִשְׁפָּ֣ט יַחֲב֑וֹשׁ וְאִם־ צַדִּ֖יק כַּבִּ֣יר תַּרְשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: ha·’ap̄ śō·w·nê miš·pāṭ ya·ḥă·ḇō·wōš wə·’im- ṣad·dîq kab·bîr tar·šî·a‘
verses.literal: Could one who hates justice govern . . . Will you condemn the just and mighty One
verses.literalPt: Porventura o que odiasse o direito se firmaria? E tu condenarias aquele que é justo e poderoso?

verses.original: הַאֲמֹ֣ר לְמֶ֣לֶךְ בְּלִיָּ֑עַל רָ֝שָׁ֗ע אֶל־ נְדִיבִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ha·’ă·mōr lə·me·leḵ bə·lî·yā·‘al rā·šā‘ ’el- nə·ḏî·ḇîm
verses.literal: who says to kings You are worthless and to nobles You are wicked
verses.literalPt: Ou dir-se-á a um rei: Oh! vil? Ou aos príncipes: Oh! ímpios?

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ נָשָׂ֨א׀ פְּנֵ֥י שָׂרִ֗ים וְלֹ֣א נִכַּר־ שׁ֭וֹעַ לִפְנֵי־ דָ֑ל כִּֽי־ מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדָ֣יו כֻּלָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer lō- nā·śā pə·nê śā·rîm wə·lō nik·kar- šō·w·a‘ lip̄·nê- ḏāl kî- ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏāw kul·lām
verses.literal: who is not partial . . . to princes and does not favor rich over poor For they are all the work of His hands
verses.literalPt: Quanto menos àquele, que não faz acepção das pessoas de príncipes, nem estima o rico mais do que o pobre; porque todos são obras de suas mãos.

verses.original: רֶ֤גַע׀ יָמֻתוּ֮ וַחֲצ֪וֹת לָ֥יְלָה יְגֹעֲשׁ֣וּ עָ֣ם וְיַעֲבֹ֑רוּ וְיָסִ֥ירוּ אַ֝בִּ֗יר לֹ֣א בְיָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: re·ḡa‘ yā·mu·ṯū wa·ḥă·ṣō·wṯ lā·yə·lāh yə·ḡō·‘ă·šū ‘ām wə·ya·‘ă·ḇō·rū wə·yā·sî·rū ’ab·bîr lō ḇə·yāḏ
verses.literal: They die in an instant in the middle of the night The people convulse and pass away the mighty are removed without human hand
verses.literalPt: Eles num momento morrem; e até à meia noite os povos são perturbados, e passam, e os poderosos serão tomados não por mão humana.

verses.original: כִּי־ עֵ֭ינָיו עַל־ דַּרְכֵי־ אִ֑ישׁ וְֽכָל־ צְעָדָ֥יו יִרְאֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ‘ê·nāw ‘al- dar·ḵê- ’îš wə·ḵāl ṣə·‘ā·ḏāw yir·’eh
verses.literal: For His eyes are on the ways of a man and He sees his every step
verses.literalPt: Porque os seus olhos estão sobre os caminhos de cada um, e ele vê todos os seus passos.

verses.original: אֵֽין־ חֹ֭שֶׁךְ וְאֵ֣ין צַלְמָ֑וֶת לְהִסָּ֥תֶר שָׁ֝֗ם פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.transliteration: ’ên- ḥō·šeḵ wə·’ên ṣal·mā·weṯ lə·his·sā·ṯer šām pō·‘ă·lê ’ā·wen
verses.literal: There is no darkness or deep shadow where the workers of iniquity can hide
verses.literalPt: Não há trevas nem sombra de morte, onde se escondam os que praticam a iniqüidade.

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א עַל־ אִ֭ישׁ יָשִׂ֣ים ע֑וֹד לַהֲלֹ֥ךְ אֶל־ אֵ֝֗ל בַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō ‘al- ’îš yā·śîm ‘ō·wḏ la·hă·lōḵ ’el- ’êl bam·miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: For God need not . . . examine a man further or have him approach . . . for judgment
verses.literalPt: Porque Deus não sobrecarrega o homem mais do que é justo, para o fazer ir a juízo diante dele.

verses.original: יָרֹ֣עַ כַּבִּירִ֣ים לֹא־ חֵ֑קֶר וַיַּעֲמֵ֖ד אֲחֵרִ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yā·rō·a‘ kab·bî·rîm lō- ḥê·qer way·ya·‘ă·mêḏ ’ă·ḥê·rîm taḥ·tām
verses.literal: He shatters the mighty without inquiry and sets up others in their place
verses.literalPt: Quebranta aos fortes, sem que se possa inquirir, e põe outros em seu lugar.

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן יַ֭כִּיר מַעְבָּֽדֵיהֶ֑ם וְהָ֥פַךְ לַ֝֗יְלָה וְיִדַּכָּֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên yak·kîr ma‘·bā·ḏê·hem wə·hā·p̄aḵ lay·lāh wə·yid·dak·kā·’ū
verses.literal: Therefore He recognizes their deeds He overthrows them in the night and they are crushed
verses.literalPt: Ele conhece, pois, as suas obras; de noite os transtorna, e ficam moídos.

verses.original: תַּֽחַת־ רְשָׁעִ֥ים סְפָקָ֗ם בִּמְק֥וֹם רֹאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ta·ḥaṯ- rə·šā·‘îm sə·p̄ā·qām bim·qō·wm rō·’îm
verses.literal: He strikes them for their wickedness in full view
verses.literalPt: Ele os bate como ímpios que são, à vista dos espectadores;

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ כֵּ֭ן סָ֣רוּ מֵֽאַחֲרָ֑יו וְכָל־ דְּ֝רָכָ֗יו לֹ֣א הִשְׂכִּֽילוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer ‘al- kên sā·rū mê·’a·ḥă·rāw wə·ḵāl də·rā·ḵāw lō hiś·kî·lū
verses.literal: because . . . . . . they turned aside from Him and had no regard for any of His ways
verses.literalPt: Porquanto se desviaram dele, e não compreenderam nenhum de seus caminhos,

verses.original: לְהָבִ֣יא עָ֭לָיו צַֽעֲקַת־ דָּ֑ל וְצַעֲקַ֖ת עֲנִיִּ֣ים יִשְׁמָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: lə·hā·ḇî ‘ā·lāw ṣa·‘ă·qaṯ- dāl wə·ṣa·‘ă·qaṯ ‘ă·nî·yîm yiš·mā‘
verses.literal: They caused the cry of the poor to come before Him and He heard the outcry of the afflicted
verses.literalPt: De sorte que o clamor do pobre subisse até ele, e que ouvisse o clamor dos aflitos.

verses.original: וְה֤וּא יַשְׁקִ֨ט׀ וּמִ֥י יַרְשִׁ֗עַ וְיַסְתֵּ֣ר פָּ֭נִים וּמִ֣י יְשׁוּרֶ֑נּוּ וְעַל־ גּ֖וֹי וְעַל־ אָדָ֣ם יָֽחַד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū yaš·qiṭ ū·mî yar·ši·a‘ wə·yas·têr pā·nîm ū·mî yə·šū·ren·nū wə·‘al- gō·w wə·‘al- ’ā·ḏām yā·ḥaḏ
verses.literal: But when He remains silent who can condemn Him When He hides His face who can see Him Yet He watches over both man and nation . . .
verses.literalPt: Se ele aquietar, quem então inquietará? Se encobrir o rosto, quem então o poderá contemplar? Seja isto para com um povo, seja para com um homem só,

verses.original: מִ֭מְּלֹךְ אָדָ֥ם חָנֵ֗ף מִמֹּ֥קְשֵׁי עָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mim·mə·lōḵ ’ā·ḏām ḥā·nêp̄ mim·mō·qə·šê ‘ām
verses.literal: that godless men should not rule or lay snares for the people
verses.literalPt: Para que o homem hipócrita nunca mais reine, e não haja laços no povo.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אֶל־ אֵ֭ל הֶאָמַ֥ר נָשָׂ֗אתִי לֹ֣א אֶחְבֹּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’el- ’êl he·’ā·mar nā·śā·ṯî lō ’eḥ·bōl
verses.literal: Suppose someone says to God I have endured my punishment I will offend no more
verses.literalPt: Na verdade, quem a Deus disse: Suportei castigo, não ofenderei mais.

verses.original: בִּלְעֲדֵ֣י אֶ֭חֱזֶה אַתָּ֣ה הֹרֵ֑נִי אִֽם־ עָ֥וֶל פָּ֝עַ֗לְתִּי לֹ֣א אֹסִֽיף׃
verses.transliteration: bil·‘ă·ḏê ’e·ḥĕ·zeh ’at·tāh hō·rê·nî ’im- ‘ā·wel pā·‘al·tî lō ’ō·sîp̄
verses.literal: Teach me what I cannot see . . . if I have done wrong I will not do it again
verses.literalPt: O que não vejo, ensina-me tu; se fiz alguma maldade, nunca mais a hei de fazer?

verses.original: הַֽמֵעִמְּךָ֬ יְשַׁלְמֶ֨נָּה כִּֽי־ מָאַ֗סְתָּ כִּי־ אַתָּ֣ה תִבְחַ֣ר וְלֹא־ אָ֑נִי וּֽמַה־ יָדַ֥עְתָּ דַבֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ha·mê·‘im·mə·ḵā yə·šal·men·nāh kî- mā·’as·tā kî- ’at·tāh ṯiḇ·ḥar wə·lō- ’ā·nî ū·mah- yā·ḏa‘·tā ḏab·bêr
verses.literal: Should God repay you on your own terms when you have disavowed Him . . . You must choose not I so tell me what you know
verses.literalPt: Virá de ti como há de ser a recompensa, para que tu a rejeites? Faze tu, pois, e não eu, a escolha; fala logo o que sabes.

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֣י לֵ֭בָב יֹ֣אמְרוּ לִ֑י וְגֶ֥בֶר חָ֝כָ֗ם שֹׁמֵ֥עַֽ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’an·šê lê·ḇāḇ yō·mə·rū lî wə·ḡe·ḇer ḥā·ḵām šō·mê·a‘ lî
verses.literal: Men of understanding will declare to me and the wise men who hear me will say
verses.literalPt: Os homens de entendimento dirão comigo, e o homem sábio que me ouvir:

verses.original: אִ֭יּוֹב לֹא־ בְדַ֣עַת יְדַבֵּ֑ר וּ֝דְבָרָ֗יו לֹ֣א בְהַשְׂכֵּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: ’î·yō·wḇ lō- ḇə·ḏa·‘aṯ yə·ḏab·bêr ū·ḏə·ḇā·rāw lō ḇə·haś·kêl
verses.literal: Job speaks without knowledge his words lack insight
verses.literalPt: Jó falou sem conhecimento; e às suas palavras falta prudência.

verses.original: אָבִ֗י יִבָּחֵ֣ן אִיּ֣וֹב עַד־ נֶ֑צַח עַל־ תְּ֝שֻׁבֹ֗ת בְּאַנְשֵׁי־ אָֽוֶן׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḇî yib·bā·ḥên ’î·yō·wḇ ‘aḏ- ne·ṣaḥ ‘al- tə·šu·ḇōṯ bə·’an·šê- ’ā·wen
verses.literal: If only Job were tried to the utmost for answering like a wicked man
verses.literalPt: Pai meu! Provado seja Jó até ao fim, pelas suas respostas próprias de homens malignos.

verses.original: כִּ֥י יֹ֘סִ֤יף עַֽל־ חַטָּאת֣וֹ פֶ֭שַׁע בֵּינֵ֣ינוּ יִסְפּ֑וֹק וְיֶ֖רֶב אֲמָרָ֣יו לָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî yō·sîp̄ ‘al- ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw p̄e·ša‘ bê·nê·nū yis·pō·wq wə·ye·reḇ ’ă·mā·rāw lā·’êl
verses.literal: For he adds rebellion to his sin he claps his hands among us and multiplies his words against God
verses.literalPt: Porque ao seu pecado acrescenta a transgressão; entre nós bate palmas, e multiplica contra Deus as suas palavras.
